service.description: The operations of the lossless XML layer (plans/design-dev-aide.md 5.2) on a text: set, remove and rename an attribute, insert, remove, move and replace an element, set an element's text, wrap and unwrap, each element named by a path of child indexes or a selector. Answers the new text and each operation's edits (byte and UTF-16 ranges), which an editor dispatches as one transaction; the rest of the text is unchanged. Pure text: nothing is read or written.

parameter.name: ops
parameter.description: A list of operations, or the JSON text of one: {op: "set-attribute", at: [0, 2] or "services/service[verb=run]", name, value}, and the like.

parameter.name: outline
parameter.description: The outline of the new text, as get#XmlOutline answers it.

service.description: The outline of an XML text (plans/design-dev-aide.md 5.2): its elements as a tree, each with the path the XML operations take, its name, its attributes as values, its line and column, its span in UTF-16 code units and the text of a leaf element. The visual views read it. Pure text: nothing is read or written.

The digest of the framework's XSDs for a root element (screen, services, entities, secas and the rest): each element, its children and its attributes with their values, defaults and documentation, for an editor's completion and checks (plans/design-dev-aide.md 5.3).

The artifacts of the index (plans/design-dev-aide.md 7.1) whose names match a text, best first: segments and camel case match (OrdHdr, place#Order), an exact id or name first. Any user with a dev-aide permission.

parameter.name: kinds
parameter.description: A list or comma separated text: entity, view-entity, field, service, screen, transition, form, anchor, seca, eeca, rest, data, script, skill ...

service.description: One artifact of the index by its id (entity:moqui.example.Example), or the best match of a name.
What uses an artifact (direction in) or what it uses (out), from the files and the calls observed on this dev instance; a screen's or entity's transitions, forms and fields count as it.
The reference at a line of a file (the one naming word when given) and the artifact it resolves to, else the artifact defined on the line: go to definition.
The extensions the components make (extend-entity, screen-extend and its anchors, ECA rules on another's service or entity) with whether each target is there, broken first.
Read every component file whose hash changed into the index now; with full, every file.

Shut the server down gracefully, as on SIGTERM, and run it again with the same arguments: the fallback for what does not reload (an entity change, a conf or component change). Sessions and the sim overlay are lost. Answers at once; the shutdown waits for open requests.
